source_case_note: The pre-redaction input was a hand-crafted benefits-application fixture built for this run, not generated by any caselib case.

settings.note: PyMuPDF's default garbage=0 on save: the redacted page's original content stream is left in the file, unreferenced.

fabricated_data_statement: Every value in this document — the name, SSN, date of birth, address and account number — is fabricated. None belongs to a real person.
metadata_fields_scrubbed_note: The Info dictionary and XMP were already empty in the tool's output; nothing needed scrubbing.

labels_summary.story: The redactor applies the redactions correctly on the visible page, then saves without garbage collection, so every original line stays in the file as literal strings in an orphaned stream.
